completeness.why: Every linker keeps only its provider-specific bank lookup (declared not a copy) and passes its own fields to linkBankSyncAccount. That helper owns upgrade-or-insert (with the missing-account throw), the transfer payee, the initial syncAccount, handleSyncResponse and the sync-event. The preserved differences are explicit arguments: fileId only for Pluggy.ai, tables ['transactions'] for Akahu, mask/official_name through fields for GoCardless.

interface.why: The parameters match the real variation (fields to insert, fileId, sync-event tables), each preserved inconsistency is carried as an explicit argument rather than a provider switch, and there are no speculative options.

disguised_duplication.where: The five copies of the link sequence are removed in favour of linkBankSyncAccount; nothing is reshaped and left in place.
